description: This Java source file defines the ProductKeywordsController, a Spring MVC Controller responsible for managing product keywords in an admin interface. It includes methods for displaying, adding, removing, and paginating keywords associated with a product, handling HTTP requests, and interacting with the ProductService to perform database operations.

classes.name: ProductKeywordsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing product keyword operations such as display, add, remove, and pagination in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayKeywords
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the keywords management page for a specific product identified by productId.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Processes POST requests to add a new keyword to a product description in a specified language, updating the product in the database.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a keyword from a product description in a specified language, returning JSON response.

methods.name: pageKeywords
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return paginated keywords for a product, providing data in JSON format.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Internal utility method to set active menu items in the model for view rendering.
